verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DGX B300 docs clearly cover low-precision inference: 144 PFLOPS FP4 inference, 72 PFLOPS FP8, a 1.5x dense FP4 uplift over B200, and positioning as an LLM inference platform. A community comment independently discusses the FP4 uplift. The serving-stack half is thin: only generic NIM and NeMo deployment docs appear, and none tie a named stack to this part. missing for 10: documented B300 support for TensorRT-LLM, vLLM or llama.cpp; B300-specific serving-stack guidance; hands-on inference benchmarks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part

citations.quote: 72 PFLOPS FP8 training; 144 PFLOPS FP4 inference
DGX B300 boosts dense FP4 performance by 1.5x and attention performance by 2x over DGX B200
DGX B300 provides enterprises with a single platform to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference and training.
deploy a model that exceeds the GPU capacity of a single node
